SCI-FRUIT ORDINARY-MAP RESIDUAL-RELEARNING METHOD —
REVIEW DISPOSITION AND BOUNDARY-CLOSURE DIRECTION

The residual-relearning correction is accepted as the intended method direction.

Do not reopen that decision, the approved ordinary-MAP scope, or the frozen
generic FRUIT core.

The correct separation is:

- keep the declared scientific recipe fixed across the request;
- reconstruct each residual from the original-parent CAL realization and the
  current applied model;
- learn current centering and correlated subspace from that residual;
- resolve Theta_k;
- hold Theta_k fixed during its own application and conditional response
  queries;
- repeat learning on the next iteration's newly constructed residual.

Internal modal coordinates remain evaluations under the resolved map.
Downstream analysis/gridding coefficients remain a separate scientific role.

A repeated fit may return the same subspace. No forced subspace change,
adaptive rank, support refinement, previous-state fallback, or performance
claim follows.

1. RETAIN THE CONCRETE FIRST-METHOD PROPOSAL

For the next boundary-closure pass, retain:

- unseeded k=0 bootstrap with explicit not_applicable model-path roles;
- original-parent reruns and complete-map replacement;
- full-supported-map, both-sign feedback without amplitude thresholds;
- the proposed matching containing-pixel projector;
- fixed post-bootstrap required populations and MAP science support;
- the proposed constant analysis/gridding family with current-generation QC;
- finite L including bootstrap;
- successful terminal selection of the final required completed iteration;
- preservation of completed products when the larger required request fails.

Keep the remaining Q01 method-combination approval distinct from the already
approved relearning direction.

Describe the all-support selector as an intentionally unthresholded baseline.
It protects nuisance structure as well as sources and supplies no
source-purification or benefit claim.

Make the all-required-array barrier visible as a request-completion policy.
It does not invalidate a completed sibling product or establish statistical
independence.

2. COMPLETE THE EXACT PTC RESIDUAL-PARENT AMENDMENT

Prepare the actual bounded BC-IN scientific amendment and its clause crosswalk.

Address not only PTC's CAL-parent clauses and external-parent requirements,
but also:

- the one-immutable-parent-fit rule;
- the ordinary centering/scaling and rank rules;
- total removed signal relative to the actual residual;
- fixed-state application and kernel rules;
- REQ-099's explicit ordinary-route exclusions.

Preferred ownership:

    FRUIT constructs each residual and owns the outer recurrence.

    The authorized PTC residual-parent pass performs one configured-rank
    Learn–Resolve–Apply operation on that exact immutable residual.

    PTC gains no internal FRUIT recurrence, new source selector, adaptive
    rank, or support-changing refinement.

State exactly how this bounded use is admitted while preserving the ordinary
CAL route and its existing authority.

Do not globally replace CAL-parent language or infer that external residual
identity alone activates the route.

3. COMPLETE BC-OUT AND THE COEFFICIENT/QC RECORDS

Prepare the exact proposed MAP input/boundary/profile successor for the
FRUIT-rejoined descendant.

Retain:

- actual CAL, residual, PTC, model and rejoin parents;
- occurrence, coordinate, quantity and reference compatibility;
- producer retention and origin/influence causes;
- coefficient value-generation identity;
- fresh compatibility/QC and MAP admission decisions;
- the frozen MAP arithmetic and support meaning.

Do not relabel the rejoined signal as unchanged PTC output.

Keep retained constant gridding values separate from newly learned PCA state.
Their constant value does not eliminate their family, association, current-QC
or admission requirements.

4. BIND EXISTING SETTINGS BEFORE REQUESTING NEW DECISIONS

For Q03 and Q04, retrieve and reuse applicable approved effective-plan and
support-policy authority.

Return only genuinely missing, incompatible or request-specific choices.
Do not request precomputed eigenvectors or centering values: those are learned
results.

Retain the exact frozen MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 binding unless a separately approved
successor is explicitly adopted. Do not import candidate decisions silently.

5. KEEP THE RESPONSE AND CLAIM LIMITS

RF-01/02 remain conditional on current Theta_k.
RF-03 includes the pass's relearning.
Recursive and terminal responses retain prior model and learned-state
dependence.

The normalized MAP/model round-trip identity remains conditional on the exact
projector, support, occurrence population, quantity/reference compatibility,
and complete restoration. It is not unit astronomical response.

No full-procedure covariance, NOI method, convergence, source recovery,
pointing accuracy or performance is inferred.

6. NEXT DELIVERABLE

Return a compact approval packet containing:

- the bounded BC-IN amendment and PTC clause crosswalk;
- BC-OUT and proposed MAP admission changes;
- the coefficient-family/QC/retained-use records;
- the correction-domain/reference disposition;
- effective-plan binding results and only the remaining precise questions;
- updated source bindings and checks.

Do not generate another generic FRUIT contract or standalone scope cycle.
Do not modify frozen authorities in place.

Historical JINC control, prior method records and frozen source bytes remain
preserved. Author dispatch, amendment adoption, execution and experiments
remain separately authorized.
